name: Band Rear Delt Row
steps: Anchor a band at upper-chest height, face it holding the ends palms down, and step back into light tension.
Set your feet hip-width apart, brace your core, and keep your chest upright.
Pull your elbows wide and back at roughly shoulder height while squeezing your rear delts and upper back.
Extend your arms slowly back toward the anchor without letting the band pull your shoulders forward.
tips: Keep your forearms lined up directly behind the pull rather than letting your elbows drop.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears instead of shrugging into your upper traps.
